newsitem.title: UK: British Steel off after results.
newsitem.headline: British Steel off after results.

text.p: Shares in British Steel Plc eased further on Monday after the company said 1997 profit slumped and issued a cautious outlook for its current financial year, dealers said.
By 1130 GMT the stock was down 5-1/2p to 157-3/4p in volume of 13.5 million shares. Before the results were announced it has been traded in a range of 160-162p.
"The market is generally weak but the figures were under the consensus", one trader said.
British Steel said its pre-tax profit slumped to 451 million stg, below the analysts' consensus of 460 million.
The company said it remained cautious for the current year as the pound's strength would continue. Cost cutting initiatives would include job cuts, it said.
